item_short_desc: Rothco's Officer Cavalry Pin featues a polished design inspired by traditional cavalry insignia, this pin is perfect for adding a professional and ceremonial touch to uniforms, jackets, hats, or display cases. A durable, high-quality accessory, it stands as a tribute to the honor and history of cavalry officers.
